rule_description: Active employee has a work email address
Work email matches a valid address format
Employee cost centre exists in the finance cost centre list
Every employee has a start date
Start date is not in the future for an active employee
Leaver date is on or after the start date
Employee with a leaver date is not marked Active
Client postcode matches UK postcode format
Every active client has an account manager
Client account manager is an active employee
No duplicate client organisations
Every contact has an email address
Contact references a client that exists
Open opportunities are owned by an active employee
Open opportunities updated within the last 180 days
Opportunity references a client that exists
Opportunity value is greater than zero
Finance client account references a CRM client that exists
Active suppliers have a VAT number
Invoices are not raised against closed accounts
Invoice references an account that exists
Invoices are not posted to closed cost centres
Invoice amount is greater than zero
Invoice due date is on or after the invoice date
Invoice number appears exactly once
Credit limit is within the approved range
